start.speaker: Arthur Champion
start.text: So. You are Mekatilili wa Menza. My spies told me an old woman was wandering through the palms inciting rebellion against His Majesty's government. You are causing immense inconvenience, woman.

choices.text: Inconvenience? You bring chains to our homes and call our defiance an inconvenience?
We did not invite you or your taxes to Giriama soil, Arthur Champion.

node_champion_threat.speaker: Arthur Champion
node_champion_threat.text: Watch your tongue! The British Empire built the railway from the sea to Victoria Nyanza. We require five hundred laborers immediately. If you refuse, I will dispatch the King's African Rifles to burn every village from here to the Galana River!

node_hen_reveal.speaker: Mekatilili wa Menza
node_hen_reveal.text: You boast of your guns and armies. But tell me, Commissioner... do you see this basket in my hands?

node_hen_parable.speaker: Mekatilili wa Menza
node_hen_parable.text: Inside is a mother hen and her newly hatched chicks. Try to take one of her little ones from her! Reach your hand out and touch her chick!

choices.text: Release the hen and chicks into Champion's veranda!

node_hen_attack.speaker: Arthur Champion
node_hen_attack.text: What is this madness?! Keep that foul bird away from me! OUCH! It pecked my boots! What kind of insolence is this?!

node_mekatilili_proclamation.speaker: Mekatilili wa Menza
node_mekatilili_proclamation.text: See how she fights with beak and spur for her chicks? Even a humble bird defends her children to the death against any predator! Are the Giriama people less than a mother hen?! We will fight for our children to the last breath!

node_champion_arrest.speaker: Arthur Champion
node_champion_arrest.text: Insolent savage! Guards! Askari! Seize this woman! Sound the alarm! Do not let her escape the compound gates!

events.value: Mekatilili released the mother hen before Arthur Champion at Kwa Junda, proclaiming the Giriama would defend their children just as fiercely.
